name: Apple Fritters
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2½ quarts (2.5 L) peanut or canola oil

steps: Run the apple, sugar, eggs, butter, and salt in the food processor until a thick paste forms.
Roll paste into 3-inch balls. Dredge balls in flour. Set aside for 2–3 minutes.
Heat oil to 375°F (190°C). Add paste balls and fry until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain fritters on a cooling rack. Dust with powdered sugar before serving.

culture.text: A fritter is a portion of meat, seafood, fruit, vegetables, or other ingredients which has been battered or breaded, or just a portion of dough without further ingredients, that is deep-fried. Fritters are prepared in both sweet and savory varieties.
